Final for Publication

17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans — 2124 West Madison Street, Chicago, IL
Proposed Zoning: = RM-S Residential Multi-Unit District
Lot Area: Approx. 5,123.21 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is proposing to develop the subject property with a four-story
residential building containing eight (8) dwelling units. The proposed
building will measure 41.67 ft. in height. The subject property is a Transit
Served Location and will be supported by four (4) off-street parking spaces
at the rear. Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-0303-D optional Administrative
Adjustment and Variation and pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1003-EE of the
Chicago Zoning Ordinance, the Applicant is seeking to reduce the off-street
parking ratio from 100% (8 parking spaces) to 50% (4 parking spaces) and
is seeking all relief necessary, as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, for
the attached Plan Set.

(A) _ The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 8,833 square feet (1.73 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): 640.4 square feet per DU.
(8 residential units)

(C) The amount of off-street parking: 4 parking spaces

*The subject property is a designated Transit Served Location (Madison Street Bus
Route). Pursuant to Sec, 17-13-1003-EE, the Applicant is seeking to reduce the off-
street parking ratio from 100% (8 parking spaces) to 50% (4 parking spaces).

(D) Setbacks:
a. Front Setback: 15 ft. (proposed)
b. Side Setbacks:
East Side: 3.36 ft. (proposed)
West Side: 5 ft. (proposed)
ch Rear Setback: 38.7 ft. (proposed)

(E) ‘Building Height: 41.67 ft.
